name: C070 Phù Thủy Hồi Dây Chuyền (Trượng Ngọc Lục Bảo Nhảy Tia)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Chain-Heal Shaman's linked emerald totem staff (Trượng Ngọc Lục Bảo Nhảy Tia - C070 Phù Thủy Hồi Dây Chuyền) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete shamanic chain-heal staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (carved dark ironwood shaft with copper coils) to top-right (a forked totem head holding three cascading emerald-jade spirit crystals linked together by glowing green energy chains).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top triple-emerald totem head with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use dark ironwood, hammered copper, aged gold, and vibrant emerald-green crystals).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Triple-Emerald Chain-Heal Staff (Trượng Ngọc Lục Bảo Nhảy Tia - C070 Phù Thủy Hồi Dây Chuyền) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the triple-emerald shamanic staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): a misty ritual circle where arcing beams of emerald-green healing lightning jump between the staff's three jade crystals and outward across the battlefield.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
